title: Nicotine-Free Morning Streak
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log habit=nicotine
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| bin _time span=1d
| stats min(eval(if(hour<12,1,0))) as morning_use by _time
| eval nicotine_free_morning=if(morning_use=1,0,1)
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(nicotine_free_morning=1,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(nicotine_free_morning=0)"
| sort - _time
description: Tracks the streak of mornings where nicotine was pushed back beyond midday or skipped entirely.
value: Winning the first half of the day is often the strongest predictor that cutback plans are really taking hold.
implementation: Log nicotine events to `index=personal`; calculate whether each morning stayed clear and maintain a rolling streak.
visualization: Daily streak chart for nicotine-free mornings.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how many mornings in a row you get through without nicotine, which is often the hardest and most important window.
